title: A message to top tier conferences [D]
summary: TL;DR: Please be hard in desk rejecting AI generated papers Recently I went to two AI conferences (A and A*) and I was surprised that "AI cheaters" didn't even read their own paper before presentation! For example, a guy couldn't even answer the question of how he represented kno
reason: Reddit discussion/commentary urging conferences to desk-reject AI-generated papers; no model release, no research artifact link (no paper/preprint/benchmark), no business, policy, or OSS announcement. No rule covers it.
